key.name: orientation
key.description: "auto" follows the accelerometer; the other values set a fixed orientation of the built-in screen.

key.name: sensor-offset
key.description: Quarter turns (0-3) added to every accelerometer reading in Auto mode, for sensors mounted at an angle to the screen.

key.name: sensor-calibrated
key.description: Whether the correction has been set. If false, the first accelerometer reading in Auto sets it, so the current position keeps the current screen orientation.
